objective: Build Michigan winter search authority before demand arrives by expanding the existing Michigan Ice and cross-country ski owners rather than creating duplicate condition pages.

evidence.interpretation: This is an authority/rank problem, not a CTR problem yet. The strongest early wedge is Saginaw Bay ice-condition intent; statewide ice and XC terms are still mostly several pages deep.

iceHub: Add a crawlable Saginaw Bay ice-conditions entry point on the existing Michigan Ice hub.
Explicitly distinguish Great Lakes lake-wide ice coverage from local ice conditions and from safety.
Keep Michigan DNR safety boundaries and the existing six-water architecture intact.
xcPlanning: Add crawlable region-first Michigan cross-country ski planning coverage inside the existing statewide owner.
Keep live regional snow conditions on xcski.chrisizworski.com and operator grooming reports as trail truth.
Do not create regional keyword-doorway URLs.
treatment.snippetPolicy: Do not rewrite title, meta description, H1 or canonical on either owner in this authority phase.

measurement.windowStarts: first complete America/Detroit day after production release
measurement.seasonalityRule: August demand is intentionally sparse. Judge normalized impressions, rank movement and query diversity together; do not declare failure from raw volume before winter demand ramps.
